title: sftp sink
description: Writes the message body to a file in a directory of an SFTP server.

path.title: Address
path.description: From the URI: sftp:[//][user@]host[:port]/directory. The directory is below the login directory; after a double slash (host//dir) it is absolute

disconnect.title: Disconnect
disconnect.description: Close the connection after each use; false keeps it open between uses, until it is idle for 30 seconds

passiveMode.title: Passive mode
passiveMode.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

privateKey.title: Private key
privateKey.description: File with the private key to log in with; instead of or besides the password

privateKeyPassphrase.title: Key passphrase
privateKeyPassphrase.description: Passphrase of an encrypted private key; env DIF_SFTP_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSPHRASE (or its _FILE companion)

knownHostsFile.title: Known hosts
knownHostsFile.description: known_hosts file to check the server key against; "" for ~/.ssh/known_hosts

strictHostKeyChecking.title: Check host key
strictHostKeyChecking.description: false trusts any server, which leaves the connection open to impersonation

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds to connect and log in

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: Name of the file; the header file.name or CamelFileName, else the trace id, if empty

binary.title: Binary
binary.description: Write the body as it is instead of in charset

charset.title: Charset
charset.description: Charset of the file: UTF-8, ISO-8859-1 or US-ASCII

fileExist.title: If the file exists
fileExist.description: Override, Append, Fail (fail the message) or Ignore (write nothing)
